title: Install an app in Android Chrome
label: Android · Chrome · Install app

compatibility.note: Based on current vendor instructions. No device screenshots or tested OS/browser versions are available; version coverage is unconfirmed.

evidence.note: Original schematic artwork illustrates the documented controls, not an exact device capture.

steps.title: Open the More menu
steps.description: Open the website in Chrome. Tap the three vertical dots beside the address bar.

steps.title: Tap Install and create shortcut
steps.description: Choose Install and create shortcut from the menu. Older Chrome layouts may call this Add to Home screen.

steps.title: Tap Install
steps.description: Choose Install. Complete the prompts Chrome displays to install the app. Create shortcut is a separate option that saves a link.

intro: Use Chrome for Android. The illustrated menu labels follow Google’s current Android help, rather than its older Add to Home screen article. Documentation draft: not yet verified on a device; menu layout and confirmation prompts may vary.

completion.description: After installation finishes, open the app from your Android launcher. Home screen placement depends on your launcher and its settings.
